title: GENERATIVE AI AND AGENCY IN EDUCATION: A CRITICAL SCOPING REVIEW AND THEMATIC ANALYSIS

bias_targets.methodology: A scoping review and hybrid thematic analysis of existing academic literature to evaluate how unequal access to GenAI tools, digital poverty, and differing affluence levels exacerbate or impact educational inequalities and learner agency.
Qualitative synthesis of literature to examine how GenAI tools affect social and linguistic inequalities, specifically evaluating their impact on learners with varying levels of English proficiency.
Thematic analysis of literature evaluating how the culture-bound knowledge and inherent cultural biases of GenAI models constrain choices and diminish learner agency in educational contexts.
